name: Malaka'jin
summary: Malaka'jin shelters Horde hunters in the lower Stonetalon hills, south of Grimtotem Post. Darkspear trolls make the camp a waystation for travelers climbing from the Barrens into the mountains.

sections.title: A Hunters' Refuge
sections.body: Malaka'jin sits beside the main trail into the Stonetalon Mountains. Horde travelers find a small camp of troll hunters living off the crags and scrublands. The hunters trade supplies and fresh game with those passing through, while watching for mountain predators and Grimtotem tauren farther up the trails.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Heights
sections.body: Malaka'jin marks an early Horde foothold in Stonetalon, near the Barrens boundary. Sun Rock Retreat is a larger stronghold farther north, while this quiet camp gives Horde trackers a place to watch tribal unrest and guard the winding roads against threats.

faq.answer: Malaka'jin is a small Horde village and outpost in the southern Stonetalon Mountains. Darkspear troll hunters live there and offer shelter, trade, and supplies to travelers climbing from the Barrens.
Darkspear troll hunters make their home in Malaka'jin. They hunt mountain game and trade meat and leather with passing adventurers.
Mountain predators threaten the camp, and hostile Grimtotem tauren live directly north at Grimtotem Post. The trolls stay alert to aggression from the tribe.

faq.q: Is there a flight master here?
faq.answer: No. Malaka'jin has no flight master. Travelers through Stonetalon must use the flight master at Sun Rock Retreat, farther northwest, or follow the road on foot.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can find fellow hunters at Malaka'jin, making a home in the rugged heights far from Kalimdor's tropical shores.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Malaka'jin as a waystation on the trail between the Barrens and the northern mountain strongholds.
